name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Between Aurora and Drift, one goes with Callisto and the other with Venus.
Either Aurora goes with Dasari or Rios goes with Drift.
Either Bauer goes with Lumen, or Rios goes with Luna — but not both.
Anders, Bauer, and Fontaine go with Echo, Lumen, and Venus, in some order.
If either Drift goes with Venus or Rios goes with Drift, then Ceres goes with Forge.
Either Drift goes with Callisto or Callisto goes with Anders.
Luna goes with at least one of Rios, Aurora, or Echo.
Either Echo goes with Fontaine or Drift does not go with Luna (but not both) if and only if Rios goes with Luna.

hints.text: Suppose Dasari went with Drift — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Dasari goes with Drift.
Dasari goes with Drift, so it can't also go with Aurora.
Drift goes with Dasari, so Rios can't go with Drift.
…but now the clue “Either Aurora goes with Dasari or Rios goes with Drift” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Dasari does not go with Drift.
